onChange.script:
if currentValue.value == True:
		self.getChild("root").getChkShtInfo(None)
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)
		self.custom.clearForm = False
	
	return

config.script:
self.view.custom.step = 'Select Check Sheet' if self.view.custom.step != 'Select Check Sheet' else ''
	system.perspective.print("Setting step to: %s"%self.view.custom.step)
	return

transforms.code: return 'kanoa/border' if value == 'Select Check Sheet' else ''

params = {'chkShtVersionStateNameList': ['Released', 'In Revision', 'Draft']} if value['isGatewayAdmin'] or value['configureQuality']['enabled'] else {'chkShtVersionStateNameList': ['Released'], 'enabled': True}	
	return system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets(params)

config.script:
self.view.custom.step = 'Select Check Sheet' if self.view.custom.step != 'Select Check Sheet' else ''
	system.perspective.print("Setting step to: %s"%self.view.custom.step)
	return

self.view.custom.selection.asset.selected = True	
	if self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkSht.itemReqd: self.view.custom.step = 'Select Item'
	else: self.view.custom.step = ''	
	
	return

transforms.code: return value['assetPath'] is not None and value['selected'] is False

config.script:
if self.view.custom.step != 'Select Asset': self.view.custom.step = 'Select Asset'
	
	return

transforms.code:
assetData = None
	assets = value or []
	if len(assets) == 0: return system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'enabled': True})

	for asset in assets: 	#Handles when multiple assets have been selected
		data = system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'enabled': True, 'assetPath': asset['assetPath'] + '%'})
		assetData = system.dataset.appendDataset(assetData, data) if assetData else data
	
	return assetData
return value['itemPath'] is not None and value['selected'] is False

config.script:
if self.view.custom.step != 'Select Item': self.view.custom.step = 'Select Item'
	
	return

transforms.code:
paramsDict = {'enabled': True}
	
	itemClasses = value['itemClasses']
	itemSets = value['itemSets']
	items = value['items']

	if len(itemClasses) > 0 and itemClasses[0]['itemClassPath']: paramsDict['itemClassPath'] = itemClasses[0]['itemClassPath'] + '%'
	if len(itemSets) > 0 and itemSets[0]['itemSetId']: paramsDict['itemIdList'] = [row['itemId'] for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getItems({'itemSetIds': [itemSets[0]['itemSetId']]}))]
	if len(items) > 0 and items[0]['itemId']: paramsDict['itemId'] = items[0]['itemId']
	
	return system.kanoa.item.getItems(paramsDict)

if value['chkShtId'] is None: return False
	if value['asset']['required'] and value['asset']['selected'] is False: return False
	if value['item']['required'] and value['item']['selected'] is False: return False
	
	return True

customMethods.name: add
customMethods.script:
chkShtId = self.view.custom.selection.chkShtId
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	chkStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getStates({'enabled': True}), 'chkShtStateName', 'chkShtStateId')
	
	chkShtTriggers = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChkShtTriggers({'chkShtId': chkShtId}), 'triggerTypeName', 'chkShtTriggerId')	
	if not chkShtTriggers.has_key('Manual'):
		triggerTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('triggerTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getTriggerTypes({'triggerTypeName': 'Manual'}))
		triggerInfo = {'chkShtId': chkShtId,'triggerTypeId':triggerTypeId, 'modeId': None, 'shiftNameId': None, 'intervalMins': 10, 'delayMins': 5, 'productionCount': None, 'comingDueMins': 5, 'overDueMins': 5, 'graceMins': 10, 'enabled': True, 'modifier': None}
		chkShtTriggerId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addChkShtTrigger(triggerInfo, userId)
	else:
		chkShtTriggerId = chkShtTriggers['Manual']
	
	itemId = self.view.custom.selection.item.itemId
	assetId = self.view.custom.selection.asset.assetId	
	shiftNameId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('shiftNameId', system.kanoa.shift.getCurrentShift({'assetId': assetId})) if assetId is not None else None
	
	chkEventInfo = {
						'chkShtId': chkShtId,
						'assetId': assetId,
						'itemId': itemId,
						'shiftNameId': shiftNameId,
						'comment': None,
						'scheduledDate': system.date.now(),
						'chkShtStateId': chkStates['Due'],
						'chkShtTriggerId': chkShtTriggerId
					}
	
	chkShtEventId = system.kanoa.quality.event.addCheckEvent(chkEventInfo, userId)
	if chkShtEventId:
		system.kanoa.quality.event.updatePersistentValues(chkShtId, assetId, itemId, chkShtEventId, userId)
		
		system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkEventDataTag()
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Check Sheet has been added')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('chkShtEventAdded', {})
		self.getChkShtInfo(None)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Failed to add Check Sheet')
	
	return

customMethods.name: getChkShtInfo
customMethods.script:
#	if chkShtId is None: return
	system.perspective.print("getChkShtInfo() called with %s"%chkShtId)
	
	self.view.custom.chkShtInfo = {
				'chkSht': system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets({'chkShtId': chkShtId or -1}), 0),
				'assets': system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getAssets(chkShtId or -1)),
				'items': system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getItems(chkShtId or -1)),
				'itemClasses': system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getItemClasses(chkShtId or -1)),
				'itemSets': system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getItemSets(chkShtId or -1)),
			}

	self.view.custom.selection = {
				  "asset": {
				    "assetId": None,
				    "assetPath": None,
				    "required": self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkSht.assetReqd or False,
				    "selected": False
				  },
				  "item": {
				    "itemId": None,
				    "itemPath": None,
				    "required": self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkSht.itemReqd or False,
				    "selected": False
				  },
				  "chkShtId": chkShtId
				}
				
	if self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkSht.assetReqd: self.view.custom.step = 'Select Asset'
	elif self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkSht.itemReqd: self.view.custom.step = 'Select Item'
	else: self.view.custom.step = ''				

	return

messageHandlers.script:
#	system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)

	if payload['msgHandler'] == 'chkShtSelected':
		system.perspective.print("chkShtSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
		chkShtId = payload['selection'][0]['value']['chkShtId'] if len(payload['selection']) > 0 and payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('chkShtId') else None
		if chkShtId is not None: self.getChkShtInfo(chkShtId)

	elif payload['msgHandler'] == 'assetSelected':
		system.perspective.print("assetSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
		assetId = None
		assetPath = None
		if len(payload['selection']) > 0 and payload['selection'][0].value.has_key('assetId'): 
			v = payload['selection'][0].value
			assetId =  v['assetId'] 
			assetPath = v['path']
			
		self.view.custom.selection.asset.assetId = assetId
		self.view.custom.selection.asset.assetPath = assetPath
			
	elif payload['msgHandler'] == 'itemSelected':
		system.perspective.print("itemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
		itemId = None
		itemPath = None
		if len(payload['selection']) > 0 and payload['selection'][0].value.has_key('itemId'): 
			v = payload['selection'][0].value
			itemId =  v['itemId'] 
			itemPath = v['path']
			
		self.view.custom.selection.item.itemId = itemId
		self.view.custom.selection.item.itemPath = itemPath

	return
